name: BonDossier Demandes
author: bondossier

sections.description:
A contact form that sends an email is easy to lose: the email lands in spam, goes to an old address, or is read on a phone and forgotten. BonDossier Demandes keeps a copy of every message in your WordPress administration, so that no client request is lost.

It works with the forms already on your site. Nothing to rebuild, no new form to create:

  • Contact Form 7
  • WPForms (Lite and Pro)
  • Elementor Pro forms
  • Divi contact forms (Divi, Extra, Divi Builder)
  • Gravity Forms
  • Ninja Forms
  • Formidable Forms

What you get, without any account:

  • A Requests page: date, name, email, phone, message, the form and the page it was sent from, and a status: To handle, Answered or Put aside.
  • The requests are kept even when the email of the form never arrives, and the plugin tells you when the notification email of a form failed to leave.
  • A box on the dashboard: N requests without an answer for 48 hours, with a link to them.
  • Search, filters (to handle, answered, waiting for more than 48 hours), bulk actions.
  • Answer by email or call in one click from the request.
  • The requests of a person can be exported and erased with the WordPress privacy tools.

Sorting, with the BonDossier service (optional):

Connect the site with your email (you receive a code, nothing else to create). Each new request is then read by BonDossier and labelled: client request, sales pitch, job application, advertising or spam, or other. Sales pitches, job applications and advertising are put aside, never deleted, so that the requests to handle are the ones from clients.

  • Free: 30 requests sorted each month.
  • The BonDossier plan, 9.90 € excluding tax a month per site, first 30 days free: every request is sorted, and each client request comes with a prepared reply. You read it, then open it in your email program or copy it: nothing is ever sent for you.
  • With a BonDossier subscription (Starter or above, trial included), the plan is included as soon as the site is connected with the email of the account. One click links the site to the workspace: each client request then also becomes a client file there, where it is followed up.

The Requests page, the dashboard box and everything kept on your site work fully without BonDossier, for as long as you like. Sorting and prepared replies are done by the BonDossier service, on its servers.

External services

This plugin can use BonDossier (https://bondossier.com), a customer relationship service run by the publisher of this plugin, to sort the requests, prepare replies and keep client files.

  • When: only after an administrator has connected the site (Requests > Settings, Sort my requests) or pasted a BonDossier receiving address there. Before that, and after disconnecting or removing the address, nothing is sent.
  • Connecting: the email typed by the administrator, the address and the name of the site, and the language of the administration are sent to bondossier.com, which sends a code to that email. The code is then sent back to connect the site.
  • What is sent, for each new request: the name, email address, phone number, subject and message written in the form, the other fields of the form with their labels, the name of the form and the address of the page it was sent from. BonDossier keeps the result of the sorting and a count of the requests, not their text, unless the site sends them to a BonDossier workspace. A prepared reply is kept two days, so that a request sent again gets the same one.
  • Settings: the plan and the number of requests sorted this month are asked to bondossier.com, at most every ten minutes, when the plugin’s pages are opened.
  • The plan: the payment page is opened on Stripe (https://stripe.com), from a link given by BonDossier.
  • Checking the address: when a receiving address is saved, the plugin asks BonDossier whether it knows it (a request without any personal data).
  • Where: app.bondossier.com, over HTTPS.
  • Terms of service: https://bondossier.com/conditions
  • Privacy policy: https://bondossier.com/confidentialite

The plugin also shows a link to bondossier.com in its pages and its dashboard box. Opening it is your choice; nothing is loaded from bondossier.com otherwise.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins > Add New, or upload the bondossier-demandes folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it. A Requests menu appears.
  3. Send yourself a message through one of your forms: it appears in Requests.
  4. Optional: in Requests > Settings, Sort my requests, type your email, then the code you receive.
  5. Optional, with a BonDossier workspace: in BonDossier, open Settings, Site forms, create an address, copy it, and paste it in Requests > Settings.
sections.faq:
Do I need a BonDossier account?

No. Everything in the Requests page and the dashboard box works without an account, for as long as you like. Sorting needs the site to be connected with an email, and is free for 30 requests a month.

How much does the plan cost?

9.90 € excluding tax a month per site, with the first 30 days free. It can be stopped at any time from Requests > Settings, Manage or stop the plan. It is included with a BonDossier subscription, Starter or above: connect the site with the email of your BonDossier account.

Is a reply ever sent without me?

No. A prepared reply is shown in the request; you read it and send it yourself from your email program.

Which forms are supported?

Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor Pro, Divi, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms and Formidable Forms. A developer can send the fields of any other form with do_action( 'bondossier_demandes_capture', $fields, array( 'form' => 'Name of the form' ) ).

Are spam messages kept?

No. A message refused by the form plugin as spam, or by its captcha, never reaches this plugin.

Are files sent with a form kept?

No. Files stay with your form plugin. Passwords, captchas and consent boxes are not kept either.

Does it slow down my site?

No. A request is written in the database like a comment. When BonDossier is connected, the request to BonDossier is short (3 seconds at most) and made once the form has done its own work; when BonDossier cannot be reached, it is retried later in the background.

Who can see the requests?

Administrators. A developer can change it with the bondossier_demandes_capability filter.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

Deleting it from the Plugins page removes its table and its settings. Requests already sent to BonDossier stay in BonDossier.

0.2.3

  • Translations come from translate.wordpress.org.

0.2.2

  • A request is given the time BonDossier needs to sort it and prepare its reply (the visitor never waits for it).

0.2.1

  • The plan is included with a BonDossier subscription (Starter or above) as soon as the site is connected with the email of the account.
  • Link the site to a BonDossier workspace in one click, without copying an address.

  • Ninja Forms and Formidable Forms.
  • The notification emails that failed to leave are shown.

  • First version: Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor Pro, Divi and Gravity Forms; Requests page; dashboard box; optional sending to BonDossier; privacy tools; French translation.
